semanticDecisions: prepare may create or revise a draft TaskBrief but never freezes it
prepare creates an EvidenceBuildRequest; it must not falsely label the request as a complete EvidenceBundle
already canonical internal evidence may be selected without an external provider call, while missing facts remain explicit blockers
actual asynchronous or provider-backed Evidence building belongs to W4-01 and starts only through its own authorized execution path
responsibility output is a non-authoritative recommendation until a user or canonical policy creates or revises ResponsibilityPlan
prepare never creates Eval results, Approval, Lease, TaskRun, AgentRun, Handoff, Action, Provider Job or external side effect
same idempotency key and same request hash replays the same PreparationReceipt; a different hash conflicts
partial and unknown are never coerced to ready, and latest revisions are never substituted for exact refs
zeroSideEffectInvariants: secret and protected contact values are absent from request, response, logs and Receipt
Brief, request and recommendation append revisions and never overwrite prior facts
